# Kenney Blaster Kit

Author: Kenney
License: CC0
Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/blaster-kit

Local downloaded version: Blaster Kit 2.1. Original License.txt retained.
Phase 25 Hub uses Models/FBX format/blaster-g.fbx (Base), blaster-p.fbx
(Tier I), blaster-q.fbx (Tier II), and crate-small.fbx (Armorer storage), including their imported
materials/textures. Scene instances are scaled and attached through Unity;
gameplay prefabs and combat anchors are unchanged.
Full pack retained temporarily until manual QA and dependency-based pruning.
